name: [🐰🥚EASTER] Super Random Fighters
desc:
KICK=UPDATE

Don't expect high quality, this game was made just for fun :b

Epilepsy Warning!!!

Controls:

M1: Normal Attack 

M1 + Jump: Aerial

E: Ability 

R: Strong Ability

C + Jump: Cancel Jump 

Thumbnails by Willdiki and Rafa, Icon by Minhimanha :D

Rafa_Theskeleton, Willdiki and Minhimanha are the artists of the game.

This is a fighting game featuring characters from many franchises, inspired by Super Smash Blox. (a game that has since been deleted).

Some features may be removed in future updates. This game uses music created by other people (if you are one of the creators, please contact me if you would like it removed)

The Rooftops Map is a recreation done by eye, not a stolen model!!

The V1 model was originally created by @nix_wawa, I only edited and rigged it :)

I hope you enjoy
